title: Lesson 10: Expert RAW
sources: Samsung Expert RAW: available from the camera's MORE menu (creator's own screenshot); saves a RAW (DNG) file alongside a regular photo, with more latitude for editing

lines.text: Want editing power like a real camera?
Open More, and tap Expert raw.
It saves a raw file alongside the normal photo,
keeping far more detail in the highlights and shadows.
So when you edit, you can rescue a bright sky,
or lift dark corners, with much more room to play.
The catch? Big files, and every shot needs editing.
Follow for lesson eleven: Pro mode!
